import DA.Assert
import DA.Foldable (forA_)
import qualified DA.Map as Map
import Daml.Script

import Splice.CometBft
import Splice.DSO.DecentralizedSynchronizer

import Splice.Scripts.DsoTestUtils

testSynchronizerMigration : Script ()
testSynchronizerMigration = do
  (app, _, (sv1, sv2, sv3, sv4)) <- initMainNet
  let svs = [sv1, sv2, sv3, sv4]
      synchronizerId = "synchronizer-id"

  -- SV's onboard their nodes
  now <- getTime
  forA_ svs $ \sv -> do
    setSynchronizerNodeConfig app sv synchronizerId $ SynchronizerNodeConfig with
      cometBft = CometBftConfig with
        nodes = Map.fromList [("nodeId-1-" <> partyToText sv, CometBftNodeConfig ("pubKey-" <> partyToText sv) 1)]
        sequencingKeys = []
        governanceKeys = []
      sequencer = Some SequencerConfig with
        migrationId = 1
        sequencerId = "sequencer-id-" <> partyToText sv
        url = "sequencer-" <> partyToText sv <> ".address:1234"
        availableAfter = Some now
      mediator = Some MediatorConfig with
        mediatorId = "mediator-id-" <> partyToText sv
      scan = Some ScanConfig with
        publicUrl = "https://" <> partyToText sv <> ".example.com"
      legacySequencerConfig = Some LegacySequencerConfig with
        migrationId = 0
        url = "legacy-sequencer-" <> partyToText sv <> ".address:1234"
        sequencerId = "legacy-sequencer-id-" <> partyToText sv

  -- sequencer info are published to DsoRules and AmuletRules
  forA_ svs $ \sv -> do
    (_, nodeState) <- getSvNodeState app sv
    let  Some synchronizerConfig = Map.lookup synchronizerId nodeState.state.synchronizerNodes
    synchronizerConfig.sequencer === Some SequencerConfig with
      migrationId = 1
      sequencerId = "sequencer-id-" <> partyToText sv
      url = "sequencer-" <> partyToText sv <> ".address:1234"
      availableAfter = Some now
    synchronizerConfig.legacySequencerConfig === Some LegacySequencerConfig with
      migrationId = 0
      url = "legacy-sequencer-" <> partyToText sv <> ".address:1234"
      sequencerId = "legacy-sequencer-id-" <> partyToText sv

          info <- getSvInfoByParty app sv

          pure (info.svRewardWeight, rewardStateCid)

    let receiveSvRewardCouponFails sv round rulesCid = do
          (weight, rewardStateCid) <- getSvRewardWeightAndState sv

            openRoundCid = round._1
            rewardStateCid
            beneficiaries = [(sv, weight)]
            sv = sv
    let receiveSvRewardCoupon : Party -> (ContractId OpenMiningRound, OpenMiningRound) -> ContractId DsoRules -> Script ()
        receiveSvRewardCoupon sv round rulesCid = do
          (weight, rewardStateCid) <- getSvRewardWeightAndState sv
          -- collect reward coupon
          void $ submitMulti [sv] [dso] $ exerciseCmd rulesCid DsoRules_ReceiveSvRewardCoupon with
            openRoundCid = round._1
            rewardStateCid
            beneficiaries = [(sv, weight - 1), (extraBeneficiary, 1)]
            sv = sv
          -- check that the coupon exists and has the right weight
          coupons <- queryFilter @SvRewardCoupon sv (\co -> co.round == round._2.round)
          sortOn (.weight) (map (._2) coupons) === sortOn (.weight)
            [SvRewardCoupon with

    let createFee = openRound.transferConfigUsd.createFee.fee * openRound.amuletPrice

@@
+module Splice.Scripts.TestSvStatus where
+
+import DA.Assert
+import qualified DA.Map as Map
+import Daml.Script
+
+import Splice.DSO.SvState
+import Splice.Types
+import Splice.Util
+
+test_SvStateContractGroups : Script ()
+test_SvStateContractGroups = do
+  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
+  otherDso <- allocateParty \"other-dso\"
+  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
+  otherSv <- allocateParty \"other-sv\"
+  let reward = RewardState with
+        numRoundsMissed = 3
+        numRoundsCollected = 7
+        lastRoundCollected = Round 12
+        numCouponsIssued = 17
+      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
+      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"alpha\"; state = reward
+      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; state = node
+      report = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; number = 5; status = None
+
+  contractGroupId rewardState === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (rewardState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSv with dso = otherDso; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (rewardState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"beta\")
+
+  contractGroupId nodeState === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (nodeState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (nodeState with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (nodeState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")
+
+  contractGroupId report === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (report with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (report with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
+  contractGroupId (report with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")
+
+test_SvStateContracts : Script ()
+test_SvStateContracts = do
+  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
+  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
+  now <- getTime
+  let reward = RewardState with
+        numRoundsMissed = 2
+        numRoundsCollected = 4
+        lastRoundCollected = Round 9
+        numCouponsIssued = 11
+      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty

+        createdAt = now

+        mediatorSynchronizerTime = now
+        participantSynchronizerTime = now
+        latestOpenRound = Round 8

module Splice.Scripts.TestSvStatus where

import DA.Assert
import qualified DA.Map as Map
import Daml.Script

import Splice.DSO.SvState
import Splice.Types
import Splice.Util

test_SvStateContractGroups : Script ()
test_SvStateContractGroups = do
  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
  otherDso <- allocateParty \"other-dso\"
  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
  otherSv <- allocateParty \"other-sv\"
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 3
        numRoundsCollected = 7
        lastRoundCollected = Round 12
        numCouponsIssued = 17
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"alpha\"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; state = node
      report = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; number = 5; status = None

  contractGroupId rewardState === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSv with dso = otherDso; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"beta\")

  contractGroupId nodeState === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")

  contractGroupId report === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")

test_SvStateContracts : Script ()
test_SvStateContracts = do
  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
  now <- getTime
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 2
        numRoundsCollected = 4
        lastRoundCollected = Round 9
        numCouponsIssued = 11
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      status = SvStatus with
        createdAt = now
        cometBftHeight = 123
        mediatorSynchronizerTime = now
        participantSynchronizerTime = now
        latestOpenRound = Round 8
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"sv-name\"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"sv-name\"; state = node
      initialReport = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"sv-name\"; number = 0; status = None
      nextReport = initialReport with number = 1; status = Some status

  submitMustFail sv "'$ createCmd rewardState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd nodeState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd initialReport

  rewardCid <- submit dso $ createCmd rewardState
  nodeCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nodeState
  initialCid <- submit dso $ createCmd initialReport
  nextCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nextReport

  Some fetchedReward <- queryContractId dso rewardCid
  fetchedReward === rewardState
  Some fetchedNode <- queryContractId dso nodeCid
  fetchedNode === nodeState
  Some fetchedInitial <- queryContractId dso initialCid
  fetchedInitial === initialReport
  Some fetchedNext <- queryContractId dso nextCid
  fetchedNext === nextReport

  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nextCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvRewardState dso rewardCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvNodeState dso nodeCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso initialCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso nextCid
  pure ()
EOF
for file in daml/*/daml.yaml; do dir="${file%/daml.yaml}"; missing='"''; while read -r dep; do case \""'$dep" in *current.dar) if [ ! -f "$dir/$dep" ]; then missing="$missing $dep"; fi;; esac; done < <(sed -n '"'/"'^data-dependencies:/,/''^[''^ -]/p'"' \""'$file"); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "$dir:$missing"; fi; done | head -45'

module Splice.Scripts.TestSvStatus where

import DA.Assert
import qualified DA.Map as Map
import Daml.Script

import Splice.DSO.SvState
import Splice.Types
import Splice.Util

test_SvStateContractGroups : Script ()
test_SvStateContractGroups = do
  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
  otherDso <- allocateParty \"other-dso\"
  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
  otherSv <- allocateParty \"other-sv\"
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 3
        numRoundsCollected = 7
        lastRoundCollected = Round 12
        numCouponsIssued = 17
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"alpha\"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; state = node
      report = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; number = 5; status = None

  contractGroupId rewardState === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSv with dso = otherDso; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"beta\")

  contractGroupId nodeState === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")

  contractGroupId report === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")

test_SvStateContracts : Script ()
test_SvStateContracts = do
  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
  now <- getTime
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 2
        numRoundsCollected = 4
        lastRoundCollected = Round 9
        numCouponsIssued = 11
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      status = SvStatus with
        createdAt = now
        cometBftHeight = 123
        mediatorSynchronizerTime = now
        participantSynchronizerTime = now
        latestOpenRound = Round 8
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"sv-name\"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"sv-name\"; state = node
      initialReport = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"sv-name\"; number = 0; status = None
      nextReport = initialReport with number = 1; status = Some status

  submitMustFail sv "'$ createCmd rewardState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd nodeState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd initialReport

  rewardCid <- submit dso $ createCmd rewardState
  nodeCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nodeState
  initialCid <- submit dso $ createCmd initialReport
  nextCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nextReport

  Some fetchedReward <- queryContractId dso rewardCid
  fetchedReward === rewardState
  Some fetchedNode <- queryContractId dso nodeCid
  fetchedNode === nodeState
  Some fetchedInitial <- queryContractId dso initialCid
  fetchedInitial === initialReport
  Some fetchedNext <- queryContractId dso nextCid
  fetchedNext === nextReport

  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nextCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvRewardState dso rewardCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvNodeState dso nodeCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso initialCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso nextCid
  pure ()
EOF
for file in daml/*/daml.yaml; do dir="${file%/daml.yaml}"; missing='"''; while read -r dep; do case \""'$dep" in *current.dar) if [ ! -f "$dir/$dep" ]; then missing="$missing $dep"; fi;; esac; done < <(sed -n '"'/"'^data-dependencies:/,/''^[''^ -]/p'"' \""'$file"); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "$dir:$missing"; fi; done | head -45'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat > daml/splice-dso-governance-test/daml/Splice/Scripts/TestSvStatus.daml <<'EOF'
module Splice.Scripts.TestSvStatus where

import DA.Assert
import qualified DA.Map as Map
import Daml.Script

import Splice.DSO.SvState
import Splice.Types
import Splice.Util

test_SvStateContractGroups : Script ()
test_SvStateContractGroups = do
  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
  otherDso <- allocateParty \"other-dso\"
  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
  otherSv <- allocateParty \"other-sv\"
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 3
        numRoundsCollected = 7
        lastRoundCollected = Round 12
        numCouponsIssued = 17
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"alpha\"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; state = node
      report = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\"; number = 5; status = None

  contractGroupId rewardState === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSv with dso = otherDso; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSv with dso; svName = \"beta\")

  contractGroupId nodeState === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")

  contractGroupId report === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = \"alpha\")
  contractGroupId (report with svName = \"beta\") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = \"beta\")

test_SvStateContracts : Script ()
test_SvStateContracts = do
  dso <- allocateParty \"dso\"
  sv <- allocateParty \"sv\"
  now <- getTime
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 2
        numRoundsCollected = 4
        lastRoundCollected = Round 9
        numCouponsIssued = 11
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      status = SvStatus with
        createdAt = now
        cometBftHeight = 123
        mediatorSynchronizerTime = now
        participantSynchronizerTime = now
        latestOpenRound = Round 8
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = \"sv-name\"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = \"sv-name\"; state = node
      initialReport = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = \"sv-name\"; number = 0; status = None
      nextReport = initialReport with number = 1; status = Some status

  submitMustFail sv "'$ createCmd rewardState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd nodeState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd initialReport

  rewardCid <- submit dso $ createCmd rewardState
  nodeCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nodeState
  initialCid <- submit dso $ createCmd initialReport
  nextCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nextReport

  Some fetchedReward <- queryContractId dso rewardCid
  fetchedReward === rewardState
  Some fetchedNode <- queryContractId dso nodeCid
  fetchedNode === nodeState
  Some fetchedInitial <- queryContractId dso initialCid
  fetchedInitial === initialReport
  Some fetchedNext <- queryContractId dso nextCid
  fetchedNext === nextReport

  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nextCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvRewardState dso rewardCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvNodeState dso nodeCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso initialCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso nextCid
  pure ()
EOF
for file in daml/*/daml.yaml; do dir="${file%/daml.yaml}"; missing='"''; while read -r dep; do case \""'$dep" in *current.dar) if [ ! -f "$dir/$dep" ]; then missing="$missing $dep"; fi;; esac; done < <(sed -n '"'/"'^data-dependencies:/,/''^[''^ -]/p'"' \""'$file"); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "$dir:$missing"; fi; done | head -45'
